title: Conditional accuracy: all-length cubic precision for the dirty stride inverse
body:
PR985 uses a length admission and a conservative fifth-degree sufficient precision bound for its target-dependent rounded dirty word. This contribution proves an all-length admission and a cubic sufficient precision bound for that same constant-coefficient word. It retains the full recursion, exact source and scratch restoration, two physical data tapes, and all movement costs.

For a certified prime-power radix `r`, initial norm at most `2^m`, target error `2^-p`, and incoming grid width `w_input`, the sufficient fractional width is at most `max(p,w_input)+m+18r^3`. The signed integer reserve is at most `m+15r^3`. The proof bounds inverse errors at the positive preimage and pays for that preimage in the integer guard. It proves a zero-subtree identity and a depth-independent internal magnitude bound for the actual dirty word; it does not assume the clean-scratch PR977 identity transfers.

The common-operator subset and prefix estimates are credited to PR862 and PR905. PR985 at `9df42a99dd8497b6e7d46cd2507bb89071372640` is retained byte-exact, with its full dependency closure. The derived solver changes admission and caches the two validation reads that the simultaneous phase lane (#1038) found were read twice but charged once. An independent array observer checks each literal indexed access. Every rounded data operation, recursive child, transport step, and head return is retained.

At `r=64`, `p=128`, and `m=20`, the explicit sufficient fractional budget is 1,420,902 bits; the pinned PR985 full-word budget needs 517,236,859 bits with the same margin before any larger structural-depth admission. Both words have 4,000 leaf calls and six borrowed arrays. These are sufficient bounds, not minimum widths or timing gains.

Run:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/dirty-stride-precision/test_package.py
```

The package covers 5,220 budget certificates, 1,088 all-length thresholds, 180 coefficient extinction cases, 8,256 exponent geometries, four dirty zero subtrees, 2,322 retained power cases, 468 signed leaf cases, 80 certified kernel cases, and 18 actual uniform-preparation kernel cases. The 98 kernel cases execute 392 complete signed words and 24,848 leaf calls. A full `L=5741`, stride 2378, 12-bit example is newly admitted and checks its residual, exact inverse, and 3,952,237 paid tape moves. Twelve fault controls and a read-only relocated replay must reproduce the exact receipt. `VALIDATION.json` gives the measured local checks and omitted checks.

This is a conditional accuracy theorem with exact-rational supporting checks. The inherited supplied factor-preparation, analytic inverse, and fast scalar arithmetic hypotheses remain. It supplies no all-size factorizer, fast bit compiler, variable site phases, Lean proof, complete transform, new multiplication exponent, or measured end-to-end speedup. The selected certificate and `upstream/` are unchanged.

Prepared for Ali Romman (@aliromman) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. `NOTICE.md` preserves predecessor credit and identifies the simultaneous phase-lane accounting finding. No independent human review is claimed.

Concurrent #1025 at `6ef2168ac90d42926bceb7ac9b2e029463800c76` improves the analytic circle exponent and applies it to PR862/977's clean-scratch estimates. Its pinned proof explicitly supplies no dirty-array circuit or new inverse execution. This contribution keeps its consumed analytic inputs and proves the PR985 dirty-word transfer. A combined tighter dirty budget is a follow-up; `OVERLAP.md` records the distinction.

PR985 later advanced to `da1cdf8ed4ac9b1b8378dfec73f77ff4e81a4f70` with the same two read-once accounting corrections. This package intentionally retains the exact consumed `9df42a` predecessor. The derived solver includes the corrections and the independent access observer; no moving source was imported.

The frozen standalone package replay returned zero in 740.81 seconds on macOS arm64 with Python 3.14.7 and one CPU. Peak child memory was 41,304,064 bytes. The selected-record check and all 25 selected tests passed. The full repository suite, selected cold replay, and hosted Linux matrix were not run. The local validation record also preserves an earlier successful package run whose external timing wrapper failed after completion because macOS blocked its `sysctl` query.
